name: Special City Council Meeting Agenda
agenda_text:
PLEASE TAKE NOTICE a special City Council meeting has been called for
  Wednesday, March 25, 2020 at 11:00 a.m. This meeting will be held via teleconference
  only in order to reduce the risk of spreading coronavirus (COVID-19) and pursuant to
  the Governor’s Executive Orders N-25-20 and N-29-20.

  No physical location from which members of the public may observe the meeting and
  offer public comment will be provided. Please listen to the meeting, which will be live
  streamed at https://artesia.12milesout.com/livevideo.

  Public comment on agenda items is welcome and members of the public may submit
  written correspondence to publiccomments@cityofartesia.us to be read into the
  record for any item on which they would like to comment. Each written comment
  submitted will be read until the time limit of three minutes has been reached. Written
  comments for each item will be accepted for 2 minutes after the start of each item.

  All votes taken during this teleconference meeting will be by roll call vote, and the vote
  will be publicly reported.

  SPECIAL MEETING OF THE ARTESIA CITY COUNCIL
  (to be held during Covid-19 emergency)

  LOCATION:
  VARIOUS TELECONFERENCE LOCATIONS

  YOU MAY VIEW THIS MEETING LIVE OVER THE INTERNET AT
  https://artesia.12milesout.com/livevideo

  WEDNESDAY, MARCH 25, 2020
  11:00 A.M.

CALL TO ORDER SPECIAL MEETING

ROLL CALL

SPECIAL MEETING PROCEDURES
As a result of the Coronavirus (COVID-19) pandemic, states of emergency have been
declared in the County of Los Angeles and the state of California. The President of the
United States has declared a federal emergency. At the direction of the Governor, starting
March 19, 2020, the entire state is subject to stay-at-home orders. These measures are
imposed to reduce the risk of spreading COVID-19. To comply with these emergency
measures, the City Council meeting will be open and public but conducted via
teleconference only. This way the public, the staff, and the Council will not be physically
 in the same place. The City is endeavoring to employ technology that will allow the public
to view the meeting live and participate.

Public comment must be submitted by email to publiccomments@cityofartesia.us
Submissions should be limited to 300 words or less, and must be received prior to the
posted start time of the meeting.

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

ANNOUNCEMENT REGARDING SPEAKER CARDS AND PUBLIC COMMENTS
Under California law, public comments at special meetings are limited to subjects on the
agenda only. Public comments received prior to the commencement of the meeting will
be read at this time.

ITEMS FOR CONSIDERATION

  1. ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION NO. 20-2796, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY
  COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF ARTESIA, CALIFORNIA, DECLARING AND
  PROCLAIMING EXISTENCE OF A LOCAL EMERGENCY
  STAFF REPORT ATTACHMENT

  2. ADOPTION OF ORDINANCE NO. 20-894U, AN URGENCY ORDINANCE OF
  THE CITY OF ARTESIA, CALIFORNIA, ENACTING A TEMPORARY
  MORATORIUM ON FORECLOSURES AND EVICTIONS DUE TO
  NONPAYMENT OF RENT BY RESIDENTIAL AND COMMERCIAL TENANTS
  IMPACTED BY THE NOVEL CORONAVIRUS (COVID-19), AND SETTING
  FORTH THE FACTS CONSTITUTING SUCH URGENCY
  STAFF REPORT ATTACHMENT

COUNCILMEMBER COMMENTS

ADJOURNMENT
The City of Artesia complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you require special assistance to attend or participate
in this meeting, please call the City Clerk’s office at 562-865-6262 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting. Copies of Staff Reports are
on file in the Office of the City Clerk and are available for inspection. Anyone who requires audio assistance to listen to these
proceedings may request the use of an assistive listening device (ALD) from the City Clerk. If you require said device, please come
forward to the City Clerk at the staff table for assistance.

CITY OF ARTESIA
  ARTESIA CITY HALL, ARTESIA COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  18747 CLARKDALE AVENUE, ARTESIA, CA 90701

  SPECIAL MEETING OF THE ARTESIA CITY COUNCIL

  WEDNESDAY, MARCH 25, 2020
  11:00 A.M.
The Special Meeting of the Artesia City Council was called to order at 11:00 a.m., on
Wednesday, March 25, 2020 at Various Teleconference Locations by Mayor Ali Taj.

PRESENT:  Ali Taj, Mayor
  Rene Trevino, Mayor Pro Tem (Arrived at 11:06 a.m.)
  Melissa Ramoso, Councilmember
  Miguel Canales, Councilmember
  Tony Lima, Councilmember (Arrived at 11:03 a.m.)

ALSO PRESENT:  William Rawlings, City Manager
  Christi Hogin, Interim City Attorney
  Ernesto Sanchez, City Clerk
  Jamie Murguia, Assistant City Clerk

MEETING PROCEDURES

THE CITY CLERK READ THE MEETING PROCEDURES AS FOLLOWS:

As a result of the Coronavirus (COVID-19) pandemic, states of emergency have been declared
in the County of Los Angeles and the state of California. The President of the United States has
declared a federal emergency. At the direction of the Governor, starting March 19, 2020, the entire
state is subject to stay-at-home orders. These measures are imposed to reduce the risk of
spreading COVID-19. To comply with these emergency measures, the City Council meeting will
be open and public but conducted via teleconference only. This way the public, the staff, and the
Council will not be physically in the same place. The City is endeavoring to employ technology
that will allow the public to view the meeting live and participate. Public comment must be
submitted by email to publiccomments@cityofartesia.us. Submissions should be limited to 300
words or less, and must be received prior to the posted start time of the meeting.

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

  MOTION BY COUNCILMEMBER CANALES TO APPROVE THE AGENDA

  MOTION SECONDED BY COUNCILMEMBER RAMOSO

  Said motion carried (4-0-0-1) in the following roll call vote:

  AYES:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  Canales, Ramoso, Trevino, Taj
  NOES:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None
  ABSTAIN:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None
  ABSENT:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  Lima

  CITY COUNCIL ACTION: The Agenda was approved without objection 4-0-0-1.

  1
 ANNOUNCEMENT REGARDING SPEAKER CARDS AND PUBLIC COMMENTS

  City Clerk presented the announcement, and announced there were no speaker cards.

ITEMS FOR CONSIDERATION

  1. ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION NO. 20-2796, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL
  OF THE CITY OF ARTESIA, CALIFORNIA, DECLARING AND PROCLAIMING
  EXISTENCE OF A LOCAL EMERGENCY

  Councilmember Ramoso provided comments

  Councilmember Canales provided comments

  Councilmember Lima provided comments

  Mayor Pro Tem Trevino provided comments, and asked a clarifying question to Interim
  City Attorney Hogin

  Interim City Attorney Hogin provided comments

  Councilmember Canales requested a report from the City Manager on the fiscal impact of
  the item on the City

  City Manager Rawlings reported that the item will increase the City’s ability to recover
  costs, which Staff is tracking at $100,000 by the ended of April. City Manager Rawlings
  reported that it is imperative that the City be in the position to recover those funds, and
  the adoption of this item will help the City make a stronger case for reimbursement of the
  costs the City is incurring.

  MOTION BY COUNCILMEMBER CANALES TO ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. 20-2796, A
  RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF ARTESIA, CALIFORNIA,
  DECLARING AND PROCLAIMING EXISTENCE OF A LOCAL EMERGENCY

  MOTION SECONDED BY COUNCILMEMBER LIMA

  Said motion carried (5-0-0-0) in the following roll call vote:

  AYES:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  Lima, Canales, Ramoso, Trevino, Taj
  NOES:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None
  ABSTAIN:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None
  ABSENT:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None

  CITY COUNCIL ACTION: Consent Calendar was approved without objection 5-0-0-0.

  2. ADOPTION OF ORDINANCE NO. 20-894U, AN URGENCY ORDINANCE OF THE CITY
  OF ARTESIA, CALIFORNIA, ENACTING A TEMPORARY MORATORIUM ON
  FORECLOSURES AND EVICTIONS DUE TO NONPAYMENT OF RENT BY
  RESIDENTIAL AND COMMERCIAL TENANTS IMPACTED BY THE NOVEL
  CORONAVIRUS (COVID-19), AND SETTING FORTH THE FACTS CONSTITUTING
  SUCH URGENCY

  2
   Mayor Taj requested a Staff Report from City Manager Rawlings

  City Manager Rawlings provided a Staff Report

  Interim City Attorney Hogin provided comments

  Councilmember Ramoso provided comments, and asked for City Council to consider
  amending the ordinance to also prohibit rental increases

  Councilmember Lima asked clarifying questions to Interim City Attorney Hogin

  Interim City Attorney Hogin provided comments

  Councilmember Canales provided comments and stated that he supports the comments
  by Councilmember Ramoso that the City Council consider amending the ordinance to also
  prohibit rental increases

  City Manager Rawlings asked Councilmembers Ramoso and Canales to clarify if
  prohibiting rental increases would be for both residential and commercial properties

  Councilmember Canales and Councilmember Ramoso replied, yes

  Interim City Attorney Hogin provided comments, and recommended that the City Council
  adopt the ordinance as-is and that Staff prepare a separate ordinance to extend the anti-
  price gauging rules to rents and bring that back for City Council consideration.

  Councilmember Ramoso provided comments

  Mayor Pro Tem Trevino provided comments

  3. MOTION BY COUNCILMEMBER CANALES TO ADOPT AN URGENCY ORDINANCE
  OF THE CITY OF ARTESIA, CALIFORNIA, ENACTING A TEMPORARY MORATORIUM
  ON FORECLOSURES AND EVICTIONS DUE TO NONPAYMENT OF RENT BY
  RESIDENTIAL AND COMMERCIAL TENANTS IMPACTED BY THE NOVEL
  CORONAVIRUS (COVID-19), AND SETTING FORTH THE FACTS CONSTITUTING
  SUCH URGENCY, AND FOR STAFF TO BRING BACK TO A FUTURE MEETING AN
  ORDINANCE THAT WILL ADDRESS RENT INCREASES UNDER THE CITY
  COUNCIL’S ANTI-PRICE GAUGING AUTHORITY AND ALSO ADDRESS THE ISSUE
  OF NOT HAVING TO REPAY BACK RENT ALL AT ONCE

  MOTION SECONDED BY MAYOR PRO TEM TREVINO

  Said motion carried (5-0-0-0) in the following roll call vote:

  AYES:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  Lima, Canales, Ramoso, Trevino, Taj
  NOES:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None
  ABSTAIN:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None
  ABSENT:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None

  CITY COUNCIL ACTION: Consent Calendar was approved without objection 5-0-0-0.

COUNCILMEMBER COMMENTS

  Councilmember Lima provided comments

  3
   Councilmember Ramoso provided comments

  Councilmember Canales provided comments

  Mayor Pro Tem Trevino provided comments

  Mayor Taj provided comments

ADJOURNMENT

  Mayor Taj adjourned the meeting at 12:06 p.m.
